name: zendesk_mcp_connector
description: Zendesk MCP Toolset providing server-side tools for searching support tickets, checking ticket status, creating offline tickets, and adding ticket comments.

exposedTools.name: search_tickets
exposedTools.description: Find a customer's Zendesk tickets by their customer_email and optional status filter.

exposedTools.name: get_ticket_status
exposedTools.description: Retrieve current status, subject, priority, and recent comments for a Zendesk ticket by ticket ID.

exposedTools.name: create_offline_ticket
exposedTools.description: Create an asynchronous offline support ticket in Zendesk for issues that do not require live human chat handoff.

exposedTools.name: add_ticket_comment
exposedTools.description: Add a public comment or internal update to an existing Zendesk ticket.
